name: Snow White Eclipse
source:
Days passed peacefully with his childhood friend Blanche.

But one morning he awoke in a dirty, nameless back alley.
Why here? How? Where were his staff?
And where was Blanche...?

Lost in confusion and unable to remember
in the cold and humble walled city of Gallunboor.

Something mysterious has befallen 17 year old aristocrat Eric.
A plan has been set in motion...

Princess Tiara was attacked by an enemy in pursuit of the throne.
As the walls closed around her, the trusting girl realized her uncle was after her life.
On her finger she wore a ring which bore the royal crest.

With the king too ill to take action, Tiara and her protector Claude visited a secret ward of Gallunboor to request the help of her father's friend, General Beil.

An obscure location known as the Eclipse Test Site.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE083599.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
与青梅竹马布兰奇一起的日子平静地流逝着。但一天早晨，他在一条肮脏无名的后巷中醒来。为什么在这里？怎么来的？他的法杖呢？布兰奇又在哪里……？在寒冷简陋的加伦布尔城墙城市中，困惑不已、无法记忆。17岁的贵族埃里克遭遇了某种神秘的事情。一个计划已经启动……蒂亚拉公主遭到了觊觎王位的敌人的袭击。随着包围圈收紧，这个天真的女孩意识到她的叔叔想要她的命。她手指上戴着一枚刻有王室纹章的戒指。国王病重无法行动，蒂亚拉和她的守护者克劳德前往加伦布尔的一个秘密区域，请求她父亲的朋友贝尔将军的帮助。一个不为人知的地方——蚀之试验场。
